description: A transaction definition as Intacct holds it — purchasing, inventory or order entry. Mirror only. It exists so every process in Fuse PICKS the definition it posts to from what this company actually has, instead of carrying a name copied from another client.

fields.label: Definition
fields.description: DOCID, exactly as Intacct spells it. A posting sends this character for character.

fields.label: Area
fields.description: Which Intacct object it came from: PODOCUMENTPARAMS, INVDOCUMENTPARAMS or SODOCUMENTPARAMS.

fields.label: Class
fields.description: Order, Received, Invoiced and so on — what separates a purchase order from the receipt that converts it.

fields.label: Create Type
fields.description: A convert-only definition cannot be posted as a new document. Correct for a goods receipt, which converts the order; wrong for a production run, which does not.

fields.label: Numbered by Intacct
fields.description: Without a numbering scheme Intacct rejects the post with PL01000127 'Document Number is missing' — an error that says nothing about numbering and sends you looking at the line items.

fields.label: Updates Cost
fields.description: Whether the definition values the movement. A cost is only ever sent where this is true — on a consume leg it would overwrite Intacct's own valuation.

fields.label: Direction
fields.description: Increase or Decrease. The definition applies its own sign, which is why quantities are always sent positive.

name: Intacct Transaction Definition
